paper_metadata.title: Alloying effects on phase stability and mechanical properties of Co-Fe-Ni high-entropy γ-γ' Superalloys

evidence.quote: Nine cast multi-principal element superalloys with novel compositions are studied, comprising (i) a high-entropy equiatomic CoFeNi matrix

Twelve high-entropy superalloys were investigated — with nine comprising an equiatomic CoFeNi γ -matrix — alloyed with lightweight γ’ formers (Al, Ti, V), additions of refractory elements (Nb, Ta, Mo), and Cr.

mechanisms.name: partitioning of Cr to the matrix

evidence.quote: we hypothesize that partitioning of Cr to the matrix may cause lightweight γ’ -formers in HEA-xCr to more strongly partition to γ’ , changing the lattice misfit.
